TH_SAKUYA-ANOTHER_ME_BUT_DOG.title: Another Me in a Cardboard Box
TH_SAKUYA-ANOTHER_ME_BUT_DOG.pages.INITI:
You see a puppy in a cardboard box by the roadside. For some reason, she looks [jitter]almost exactly like you[/jitter], except she has a pair of animal ears.

Seeming to notice your arrival, she looks [jitter]very excited[/jitter], trots quickly to your feet, and rubs her furry head against your heel.

So, what do you do?
TH_SAKUYA-ANOTHER_ME_BUT_DOG.pages.BUY_P: Seeing how cute she is, you can't bear to leave her here to suffer in the wind and sun. Instead, you pick her up along with the cardboard box and take her in.
TH_SAKUYA-ANOTHER_ME_BUT_DOG.pages.BUY_H:
Although she is indeed very cute, now is not really a good time to keep a pet.

So, you ignore her pitiful look and continue deeper into the tower.
TH_SAKUYA-TWISTED_TIMELINE.title: Temporal Distortion
TH_SAKUYA-TWISTED_TIMELINE.pages.INITIAL:
While using time stop to travel, you feel a [jitter]strong attractive pull[/jitter], your vision goes dark, and you pass out.[fly_in]

When you open your eyes again, you find yourself in a chaotic temporal distortion. The path you walked before hasn't collapsed, but it's no longer safe. Now there are three roads ahead of you. Although very twisted, you can roughly tell which timeline they correspond to.[/jitter]

So, what do you do?
You choose to walk toward the future timeline.

Accompanied by a [jitter]twisting pulling sensation[/jitter], you are dragged into the future.

When you wake up again, you find that everything around you has become completely different.
TH_SAKUYA-TWISTED_TIMELINE.pages.NOW.des:
You choose to continue moving forward on the present path.

Although the road is hard to see, you eventually reach your destination without too much cost, benefiting greatly.
TH_SAKUYA-TWISTED_TIMELINE.pages.PAST.de:
You grit your teeth and walk toward the past timeline, trying to actively break free from this chaotic [jitter]temporal distortion[/jitter].

After a bout of [purple]excruciating pain[/purple] that threatens to [jitter]tear your body apart[/jitter], you find a mysterious [blue]clock[/blue] and use it to successfully escape this area.
TH_SAKUYA-BLOOD_CAKE.title: Blood Cake
TH_SAKUYA-BLOOD_CAKE.pages.INITIAL.descr:
Unknowingly, you arrive at a cake workshop.

You suddenly remember that Milady once said she wanted to eat a blood cake, but you couldn't find one back then. Although Milady never blamed you for it, you still feel guilty. Now that you have the chance, you naturally want to make such a cake to make it up to her.

However, the most important thing is to find the ingredients first. Your own blood isn't enough to make such a large cake.

So, what do you do?
TH_SAKUYA-BLOOD_CAKE.pages.BUY.descripti:
As the head maid, you know very well when to save and when to spend.

Buying directly is much faster than collecting materials yourself, and the cake can be made right here and taken home.
TH_SAKUYA-BLOOD_CAKE.pages.INITIAL.optio: [gold]Remove[/gold] all your starting [gold]Strikes[/gold]. Add [blue]4[/blue] [gold]Redder Than Blood[/gold] to your [gold]deck[/gold].
TH_SAKUYA-BLOOD_CAKE.pages.COLLECT.descr: You decide to collect the materials yourself, as a way to make it up to Milady. Something made by your own hands is far more thoughtful than something bought with money, and it better represents your feelings.
TH_SAKUYA-LIBRARY.title: Bavarian Grand Library
TH_SAKUYA-LIBRARY.pages.INITIAL.descript:
You pass by an abandoned magnificent building, whose style is strikingly similar to Lady [purple]Patchouli[/purple]'s library.

The sign on the wall has fallen to the ground, bearing the words "Bavarian Grand Library".

You enter the building and see countless scrolls, manuscripts, and books.

So, what do you do?
Choose a card from your deck to add to your [gold]deck[/gold].
TH_SAKUYA-LIBRARY.pages.READ.description:
You grab a random book and start reading. It tells the story of a family across eight generations constantly struggling and achieving self-redemption.

The plot is full of twists, turns, and dangers. The family members show courage and wisdom when facing evil forces, while also experiencing growth and change.

After finishing the book, you feel satisfied and enriched.
TH_SAKUYA-LIBRARY.pages.SLEEP.descriptio:
You take a nap in an armchair.

[fade_in]Zzz...zzz.....Zz....[/fade_in]

When you wake up, you feel refreshed.
TH_SAKUYA-LOST_HUNTER.title: Lost Vampire Hunter
TH_SAKUYA-LOST_HUNTER.pages.INITIAL.desc:
As you pass by a maze, you see a well-equipped human squad. From the silver gear, crosses, and wooden stakes they carry, it's highly likely they are vampire hunters.

They are currently wandering near the maze, troubled by finding the exit.

So, what do you do?
TH_SAKUYA-LOST_HUNTER.pages.IGNORE.descr: After observing them for a while, you determine they pose no threat to Lady Remilia and decide to ignore them and continue on your way.
TH_SAKUYA-LOST_HUNTER.pages.KILL.descrip:
Although you have no grudge against them, as a [red]vampire's servant[/red], it is necessary to eliminate potential threats to your master —

[fade_in]Even if they might never reach Gensokyo in their lifetime, the threat must be [jitter][red]nipped in the bud[/red][/jitter].[/fade_in]
TH_SAKUYA-LOST_HUNTER.pages.INITIAL.opti: Add a [gold]Letter of Thanks[/gold] to your [gold]deck[/gold].
TH_SAKUYA-LOST_HUNTER.pages.LEAD.descrip:
Since you are also human, you don't mind pointing them in the right direction —

[fade_in]After all, they will probably never find Gensokyo in their lifetime and pose no threat to Lady Remilia.[/fade_in]

After that, the leader-looking person gives you a letter of thanks. Although it's not necessary, you accept it for the time being and then continue on your way.
TH_SAKUYA-LOST_FRIEND.title: Missing Person Notice?
TH_SAKUYA-LOST_FRIEND.loss: Your intent was seen through and you were counter-killed.
TH_SAKUYA-MEET_SAKUYA.pages.INITIAL.desc:
On your way to the higher floors, you notice a group of people holding a stack of portraits, stopping passersby to ask questions.

Out of curiosity, you approach them and learn that they are [jitter][gold]looking for a lost companion[/gold][/jitter], promising a great reward to anyone who can help find them.

After looking at the portrait of their companion, what do you do?
TH_SAKUYA-MEET_SAKUYA.pages.SHOW.descrip:
[fade_in]"I've seen them, near a maze. I pointed them the way back then."[/fade_in]

You think for a moment, remembering that you've indeed seen such a group. You take out the letter of thanks from your pocket and hand it to the leader.

[fade_in]"Really? Thank you so much!"[/fade_in]

After confirming the letter, the leader takes a heavy bag of gold coins from his chest and hands it to you as a reward.
TH_SAKUYA-MEET_SAKUYA.pages.INITIAL.opti:
[blue]50%[/blue] chance to lose HP equal to [red]50%[/red] of max HP.
[blue]50%[/blue] chance to gain [blue]5[/blue] random [gold]Relics[/gold].
TH_SAKUYA-MEET_SAKUYA.pages.KILL_SUCCESS:
You look at their supplies; they seem quite valuable. Just in time, the Scarlet Devil Mansion needs funds for reconstruction. It might be better to trick and kill them and take their supplies directly.

So, you trick them into a deadly trap and successfully obtain their supplies.
You look at their supplies; they seem quite valuable. Just in time, the Scarlet Devil Mansion needs funds for reconstruction. It might be better to trick and kill them and take their supplies directly.

So, you trick them into a deadly trap, but they manage to escape and attack you fiercely. You are forced to flee the scene in disgrace.
TH_SAKUYA-MEET_SAKUYA.pages.IGNORE.descr: You take a look and realize you don't recognize the people in the portraits. Adhering to the principle of "less trouble is better," you decide to ignore them and continue on your way.
TH_SAKUYA-STRANGE_INVITE.title: Strange Banquet Invitation
TH_SAKUYA-STRANGE_INVITE.pages.INITIAL.d:
You encounter a strange "person" on the road. It is short, carrying a tray, and looks somewhat comical, but its pointed nose and [jitter][red]blood-dripping scarlet fangs[/red][/jitter] are rather terrifying.

It hands you a yellowed invitation and, without explanation, leads you toward an unknown direction. As if under a spell, you do not resist and follow it to an unknown place — [jitter]a dilapidated [thinky_dots]... courtyard.[/jitter]

When you come to your senses, you find that a crowd of [jitter]grotesque creatures[/jitter] has gathered around you. They look human but have [jitter][green]insect-like[/green][/jitter] features, sending [jitter]chills down your spine[/jitter].

"[fade_in][red][jitter]Eat[thinky_dots]... eat[thinky_dots]...[/jitter][/red][/fade_in]" Their voices echo in your ears, as if urging you.
TH_SAKUYA-STRANGE_INVITE.pages.REFUSE.de:
Blindly eating something so suspicious is not a wise decision. You refuse to eat.

[jitter]The strange creatures then rush at you one after another.[/jitter]

After paying a considerable price, you finally get rid of them.
TH_SAKUYA-STRANGE_INVITE.pages.INITIAL.o: [green]Restore[/green] all HP. Add a [red]Scarlet Curse[/red] to your [gold]deck[/gold].
TH_SAKUYA-STRANGE_INVITE.pages.EAT.descr:
Although you don't want to eat this suspicious food, the situation forces your hand. You reluctantly accept their invitation, suppressing the [jitter]nausea[/jitter] in your heart, and put a piece of steak in your mouth.

[red][jitter]The call cannot be stilled... fear cannot be stopped...[/jitter][/red]

A sinister force permeates your body, turning you into the same kind of grotesque existence as them.
TH_SAKUYA-STRANGE_INVITE.pages.DRINK.des:
[red][jitter]The call cannot be stilled... fear cannot be stopped... only blood can temporarily calm your urges[/jitter][/red]

You rush toward the "red wine" — you know it: that is the [red][jitter]Blood Brew[/jitter][/red] you crave!

After drinking a few gulps, you secretly stash some in your pocket for future emergencies.
